0022600090.text: Both the Indiana Pacers and New Orleans Pelicans are opening their 2026-27 seasons, so neither team has a record yet. The Pacers are without Johnny Furphy, who is out following knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Pacers winning the most recent meeting 127-119 in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Indiana a 65% chance to win.
